title: Which stadium will UEFA select to host the 2029 men's Champions League final?
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : UEFA's official announcement awarding hosting rights for the 2029 men's Champions League final, or reliable contemporaneous reporting of that announcement. 
  Resolution Date : Resolve when UEFA publicly announces its venue selection. Subsequent venue changes will not alter the answer. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the selected stadium.
